full_name: Kiran Stallone | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Frieda L. Miller Fellow Independent Scholar
bio: Trained in sociology and political science, Kiran Stallone is a senior researcher specializing in gendered patterns of violence and civilian protection measures in war and conflict. At Radcliffe, Stallone will work with Leigh A. Payne to examine armed actors’ confessions to rape in the Colombian conflict.
